title: Carved Four-String Violin
description: Original static low-poly single violin lying on a finite flat back. A warm amber waisted body has a real hollow rib cavity and two cut-through f-shaped soundholes. Four individual solid strings run from a supported tailpiece across a two-foot arched bridge and a fretless curved ebony fingerboard to the nut and four alternate-sided pegs in an open pegbox. A carved spiral scroll, honey maple neck, fine purfling rim, tail saddle, button and paired tailgut complete the single editable instrument. All named components are physically connected to the grounded backplate; actual cavity, f-hole apertures, string/fingerboard clearance and bridge-foot support are checked. Approximately 0.67 m long visual proportions; metres, source Z up, scroll toward +Y and origin at the ground projection of the body centre. Six solid PBR materials, no textures or external dependencies. Distinct violin anatomy, not a reduced six-string fretted guitar. Static game visual only; no bow, case, stand, sound, animation, playability, instrument-size accuracy or safety certification.
